prompt: Create ONE wide LANDSCAPE 16:9 fine architectural ink-and-watercolour illustration on warm cream art paper. This is a new distinct candidate in the approved Artemis Atlantic Heritage Watercolour series, using the attached image as a STYLE AND BUILDING-FAMILY reference, not a scene to copy. Hand-drawn dark sepia nib, delicate precise cross-hatching, transparent layered watercolor washes, limestone cream/ochre, volcanic basalt grey, restrained bronze, natural greens, quiet Atlantic blue-grey. Airy unfinished vignette edges, sophisticated calm composition, soft natural light. No photorealism or computer 3D, no people, no text, captions, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, amphorae, deeds or money. No exact parcel, approved architectural plan, guaranteed amenity or documentary project-progress claim. One landscape illustration only. A small calm bedroom-and-loggia concept, cream lime plaster, linen-covered simple bed, restrained dark timber bedside table and bronze-framed door to a shaded planted loggia. Oblique view from one corner, entire room composition at human scale. The exterior is foliage and diffuse sky rather than a guaranteed sea view. No people, decorative amphorae or hotel branding.
rights_basis: New concept illustration from approved project style reference; public-use clearance remains pending
